title: Variance inflation factor as a named collinearity diagnostic
dek: VIF_j = 1/(1−R²_j). Wikipedia collinearity node. Not a causal discovery and not a p-value.
story: VIF on Wikipedia measures how much the variance of a coefficient is inflated because other covariates already explain that column of X. VIF=1/(1−R²_j) from the regression of X_j on the rest.

It is a design-matrix diagnostic, not a reason to drop a confounder you needed (stats-confounding / omitted variables). High VIF plus a needed covariate means get more data or a better design, not automatic deletion.
stats-ols-diagnostics is the residual-and-leverage plate. This card is the named collinearity number.
deep: Perfect collinearity makes VIF infinite and XᵀX singular.
Dummy traps (all levels plus intercept) are VIF explosions you caused.
Ridge/shrinkage can buy a finite estimate at the price of bias (bias-variance plate).
GWAS PCs can be collinear with lineage — that can be a feature.

visual.caption: Teaching bars: VIF as variance inflation, not as a licence to delete confounders.

steps.title: Dropping the scientific factor is not the repair
Drop PCs, or combine, or hierarchical model

example.takeaway: VIF diagnoses collinearity. It does not pick the scientific model.
